# myArkived

myArkived is a portfolio project designed for tracking, logging, and reviewing fan-fiction. It provides a dedicated space for the community to keep an organized record of the stories they read.

## Developer
Built by **[PilarPaladin]**.

## Core Functionality
- Track and log fan-fiction progress.
- Write reviews and rate favorite works.
- Secure user authentication powered by Supabase.
